## About the Author

This project was developed by **Omar Khater** as part of Milestone 5 for data science coursework in quantitative reasoning and data visualization.

## Project Scope

This project examines anti-doping testing patterns and adverse analytical findings (AAFs) across competitive sports, linking testing regimes with athlete physiological profiles and sport-specific physical demands.

## Data Sources

- **Olympic Athlete Records**: Historical dataset covering 120 years of Olympic competitions (271,116 records), sourced via [TidyTuesday](https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/tree/master/data/2021/2021-07-27).
- **Anti-Doping Statistics**: Testing figures, sample breakdowns, and adverse analytical findings from the [World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA)](https://www.wada-ama.org/en/resources/anti-doping-stats) and the [U.S. Anti-Doping Agency (USADA)](https://www.usada.org/news/testing-data/).

## Repository

The source code and data pipeline for this Quarto website can be found on GitHub: [okhatter28/milestone5](https://github.com/okhatter28/milestone5).
